name: Midwest Wire Products Inc.
old_description: Midwest Wire Products is a full-service metal forming company specializing in the production of custom wireforms and stampings. We have a broad range of manufacturing capabilities, enabling us to produce a wide range of wire form and stamped products.
about:
Midwest Wire Products, LLC operates from Sturgeon Bay, Wisconsin, as a full-service metal forming company specializing in custom wireforms and stampings. The company provides engineering support to help customers finalize designs and develop effective manufacturing solutions.

Its manufacturing capabilities include straightening and cutting wire, fourslide and multislide forming, stamping, buffing, resistance, automatic, heli-arc and arc welding, CNC bending, drilling, threading, tapping, and assembly. An in-house tooling department supports production, and the company offers logistics support for inventory control as well as quick, cost-efficient prototype and sample production.

The company serves customers across a range of industries that require custom wire forms and stampings, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials.

Midwest Wire Products emphasizes value and satisfaction, backed by an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system. Its differentiators include in-house tooling, logistics support, rapid prototyping, and engineering collaboration to optimize designs for manufacturability.
